client.business_model: Physician-led, multi-site dermatology network providing medical, surgical and cosmetic skin-care services across New England
client.client_history: Founded in 1992 as a solo practice, APDerm has grown through acquisitions and new-office openings to become the largest physician-led dermatology practice in New England, operating dozens of clinics in Massachusetts, New Hampshire, and Rhode Island.

revenue.source: LeadIQ (2.7 M USD, Dec-2025) vs Growjo (44.7 M USD, 2024)
revenue.notes: Publicly available estimates vary widely (2.7 M–44.7 M). No figure from company or filings; therefore amount is set to null.

locations.source: apderm.com About-Us page ("over 30 locations", accessed 2026-01) vs apderm.com blog post 2026-01 ("24 locations")
locations.notes: Official website gives two different counts ("over 30" and 24). Using midpoint 27 as representative; exact number unclear.

employees.notes: Employee estimates range 154–501. Average of available figures (~350) shown; no LinkedIn headcount located in provided sources.

extraction_sources: Agreement/Procurement Cost Reduction Services Agreement_APDerm_12.11.20 - signed.pdf (page 1)
apderm.com About-Us page (web search result: Company Overview)
apderm.com blog post on partnership with Dermatology Professionals (web search result: PE/Ownership)
extraction_notes: Official company name confirmed in signed services agreement (“Adult & Pediatric Dermatology, PC”).
Private-equity ownership explicitly stated in Treya case study and Provident/Waud Capital web sources.
No reliable, consistent revenue figure available; wide variance across estimation sites with no corroboration from official sources.
Location count conflicted between two statements on company website (24 vs “over 30”); selected midpoint and marked confidence as medium.
Employee count highly variable across data-scraping sites; no definitive LinkedIn data provided, so average used with low confidence.
